releaseNotes:
Nokiatis MUC 1.14.0 — your headphones now run the show.

• Music pauses the moment your Bluetooth earbuds go back in the case, or a cable is unplugged — no more blasting the phone speaker in public.
• Connecting Bluetooth mid-song no longer freezes playback: the app re-attaches to the new output and continues from the same second by itself.
• New Settings → Playback switch: Pause when headphones disconnect (on by default).
• Update checks now see a new release within minutes instead of half an hour.
• Website fixed: it now always shows the real newest version.
